clue: After building their amazing treehouse, the shipwrecked Robinsons must defend their island from a gang of these.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is pirates! Log traps, coconut bombs and tumbling boulders. And the treehouse lives on in Magic Kingdom's Adventureland.

clue: In 2010's Tron: Legacy, Sam Flynn learns his father Kevin was overthrown inside the Grid by this digital copy of himself.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is CLU! Jeff Bridges plays him too, digitally de-aged. [laughs] Imagine your own copy stealing your job. Rude.

clue: Shrunk to the size of bugs, the Szalinski kids ride across their backyard on a friendly one of these insects they nickname Anty.
reveal: [sighs] The correct answer is an ant! Anty bravely fights off a scorpion to save them. [laughs] EPCOT later shrunk whole audiences with Rick Moranis.

clue: In 2009's Avatar, Jake Sully learns the ways of the Na'vi from this Omaticaya princess.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Neytiri! Her world inspired Pandora at Animal Kingdom, banshees and all. [whispers] I see you.

clue: In Disney's 1954 film, Captain Nemo's crew on the Nautilus battles a giant one of these sea monsters.
reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is a giant squid! The film won an Oscar for its special effects, and Magic Kingdom sent guests sailing in Nautilus subs until 1994.

clue: Judge Doom plans to wipe out Toontown with this toxic mix of turpentine, acetone and benzene.
reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is the Dip! The only thing that can kill a toon. Disneyland's Toontown has Roger's car-spinning ride to cheer you up.

clue: Bernard and Bianca fly to Australia on the back of this clumsy albatross, the brother of Orville.
reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Wilbur! Orville and Wilbur, named after the Wright brothers. Albatross Air: not the smoothest landing.

clue: In Toy Story 4, the antique doll Gabby Gabby wants to take this working part from Woody.
reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is his voice box! Gabby's was broken. Thankfully, there's a snake in Woody's boot... and a heart in his stuffing.
